caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with detailed line work showing intricate lace or embroidery patterns on the main part of the fabric. The bonnet features various floral and decorative motifs, including leaves, vines, and cloud-like shapes. The edges have a scalloped or frayed appearance. At the right side of the bonnet, there is a large, colored bow composed of wide ribbon with green and white stripes and a checked pattern. The drawing primarily uses pencil or graphite for the outlines and details of the bonnet, while the bow is rendered using green and white coloring on the same tan paper background, making it stand out as the only colored element in the composition. The overall layout focuses on the side profile of the bonnet, emphasizing its decorative details and the prominent bow.
title: Cap
